title: feat(i18n): label the list_flow_runs chat step in every locale pack
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97KVmecjyPpyMzgf4Ct9yt5)_

Fixes #34368

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：10 个内置语言包各加一条 `chatbot.tool.list_flow_runs` 聊天步骤标签（en「Check automation runs」，zh-Hans「查看自动化运行记录」，zh-Hant 由生成器重生成）；7481 标签覆盖测试的 `AHEAD_OF_PIN` 暂挂这个工具名。
- 为什么改：cloud 新增的 `list_flow_runs` 工具（读一个流程最近的运行记录）在中文等界面里显示成英文「List flow runs」，用户看不懂。
- 风险与回滚：只加文案和一行测试名单，不动运行逻辑；回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts`（新标签与改正的注释）、`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts`（`AHEAD_OF_PIN`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Every built-in locale pack (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans}.ts`) gains `chatbot.tool.list_flow_runs`, placed in the tool block's sorted order. en `'Check automation runs'`, zh-Hans `'查看自动化运行记录'` as the card asks; the other eight are a short verb-first sentence that names the flow the way each pack's `test_flow` / `toggle_flow` neighbours already do (no pack says "automation" in a user-facing value today).
- `zh-Hant.ts` is regenerated with `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant`, not hand-edited.
- `toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts`: `AHEAD_OF_PIN` carries `'list_flow_runs'`, the file's hatch for a tool the cloud registers before the pinned `@objectstack/spec` lists it. Its header note no longer says the list is empty. **Forced test edit**: this is the only edit to a test, and it adds coverage (every pack must now carry the label, and the zh case resolves it through the pack).
- The comment above each pack's `chatbot` block said `test_flow` / `toggle_flow` are "newer than the registry". The 7481 suite's `GRADUATED` list asserts they are in it, so that sentence is corrected in the packs this PR already edits, and the suite name it cited is spelled as the file is (`toolLabels-locale-parity-7481`).
- Changeset `.changeset/34368-list-flow-runs-label.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Why

The cloud package `service-ai-studio` registers `list_flow_runs` so the build agent can answer "did my automation work?" from a run's own error. With no pack entry, `humanizeToolName` fell back to the English title-caser, so the step read "List flow runs" in every language.

The registry half (`PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` in `packages/spec`) is split off to the spec-lane card #34372, because it widens what tool-reference validation accepts. When #34372 lands, `list_flow_runs` moves from `AHEAD_OF_PIN` to `GRADUATED` in the 7481 suite; that suite's last case reds until it does. The cloud side deletes its AHEAD entry for this name on the pin bump that carries the registry entry; that is not done here.
